morning.caption:
Enverus estimates about 90% of the water tied to AI inference is consumed at the power plant, not the data center. It puts $25 a month of frontier AI use at about 1.9 gallons, power generation included.

Full edition: watercapitalwire.com

afternoon.caption:
The Illinois Commerce Commission approved a $74 million rate increase for Illinois American Water, $53 million less than requested, and set return on equity at 9.67%, below the current 9.84%.

More: watercapitalwire.com

#Water #Utilities #RateCase #Infrastructure #Illinois

evening.caption:
Fiji declared a nationwide state of disaster on November 18 as an El Niño driven drought reached crisis level, with remote and island communities under growing water pressure and below normal rain expected into early 2027.

More: watercapitalwire.com
